privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Voice and AI features
privacy.intro: This policy explains the personal information we process when you use live captions, translated captions, voice translation, AI meeting notes and in-person notes in a seminar. These features use an external AI service, so the information is transferred abroad.
who: Presenters and participants on stage: we ask for your consent once, before you first turn on your microphone. You can join the seminar without consenting.
Audience: you do not use a microphone, so no voice is sent. You only see captions and notes.
In-person notes: an admin records a meeting with a microphone and confirms that attendees were informed before recording.
privacy.xferTitle: Transfer of personal information abroad (Korean Personal Information Protection Act, Art. 28-8)

xfer.v: Google LLC (Gemini API) — contact [TBD: Google privacy contact]
United States and other countries where Google data centers are located [TBD: processing region]
About every 5 seconds while a feature is on, over an encrypted connection (HTTPS).
Voice, spoken content (text), speaker display name (for note summaries), screen-share screenshots (when AI notes are on)
Speech to text, translation, meeting-note summaries, synthetic speech (standard voices, no voice cloning)
Ends as soon as the result is returned. We ask Google not to store requests (store=false). Abuse-monitoring logs may still be kept under Google’s terms [TBD: retention period and paid-tier status].

xfer.k: How to refuse, and what happens
xfer.v: If you do not consent or turn off your microphone, no voice is sent. You can still take part in the seminar; only captions, translations and notes of your own speech are not created. You can withdraw consent at any time [TBD: where the withdraw button is].

keep: Original audio: not stored. It is discarded right after conversion to text.
AI meeting notes (when the presenter turns them on): spoken content, screenshots and the summary, kept until the notes are deleted [TBD: maximum retention].
Consent records: the time of consent and the policy version, kept as proof [TBD: retention period].
Usage: per-minute request counts and processing time, used to enforce cost limits.

Attendance: the time you joined, the time you were last connected, your display name and your Pi username are stored and given to the host as an attendance list (on screen and as a CSV download). Kept until the seminar is deleted.

Q&A and polls: the question text and the asker's display name (or Pi username if none) are visible to every participant. Upvotes and votes show only counts, never who cast them. Kept, including hidden questions, until the seminar is deleted.
privacy.rec: Recordings are saved only as a file on the presenter’s device. They are not uploaded to our servers or transferred abroad. While recording or AI notes are on, every participant sees an indicator.
privacy.rights: You can ask to access, correct, delete or stop the processing of your information. Contact: [TBD: privacy officer name and contact]
